run_training: run the OpenPCDet 3D object detection training pipeline with a YAML config file and optional distributed GPU support
run_training_with_checkpoint: run the training script resuming from a saved checkpoint file to continue training a 3D detection model
run_training_with_pretrained: run the training script using a pretrained model file as the starting point for 3D detection training
run_distributed_training: run the training script with PyTorch or Slurm launcher for multi-GPU distributed 3D object detection training
run_training_with_custom_config: run the training script with custom config overrides passed via the set argument to modify training parameters
